en.title: Shift n-th Consonant
en.description:
Count consonants from the left; the n-th, 2n-th, 3n-th… consonants are replaced with the next consonant, preserving case, with z wrapping around to b. Vowels and non-ASCII letters are kept as is and are not counted.

The problem semantics follow the fixed OAMaster snapshot; the input protocol and limits supplemented by this site are defined by this site.
en.input: The first line contains n (1..10⁹), and the second line contains message (≤200000 ASCII printable characters, possibly including spaces). Only A-Z/a-z are treated as English letters; this rule is an explicit site supplement.
en.output: Output the entire transformed line as is; spaces must be preserved.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the full approach, proof, and complexity.
